notes: The author describes E′(M,N) as a complex agreeing with the invariants of E(M,N) outside an uncertainly written degree condition, and gives a short exact sequence in degree 2. The label of that display and its final endpoint remain damaged.
The displayed middle term is named P(M,N) above an overbrace; the arrow to underlined Hom(M,₂N) is labelled sigma. All arrows point right. These are readings of ink, not a verification of exactness.

The interpretation is explicitly introduced by Heuristiquement. The author assumes that the recipient’s theory of strict Picard 1-champs extends to strict Picard 2-champs, adding ce qui pour moi ne fait guère de doute. The explicit qualification is retained.

The author then says the exact sequence can be constructed canonically à la main and begins to describe its middle term as a sheaf of classes (or données, less likely) up to équivalence. The page stops after près des and the sentence remains unfinished.
No date or author page number is visible. The supplied H marker page 4 is treated as editorial page identification, not as author ink. Archive foliation 62 is recorded in a TeX comment.

Potentially mathematical issues prompted local ink inspection of the degree comparison, the display label, terminal zero, plural champ(s) endings, and the H exponent. No targeted mathematical proof, counterexample, or derivation was performed; checks is therefore empty.

The small comma-like trace before moi is absent in both witnesses. Its intentional status remains uncertain. The two coarse curves at the lower-left copy edge remain nonlexical impressions, not an invented marginal phrase.
The notation snapshot was used only as a prompt. No other page, reader output, OCR, web material, or external transcription was consulted.

coverage: The entire 1685 × 2361 source page was inspected once for layout, followed in order by each supplied full-resolution half once. Every prose line was read against both complete witnesses, including agreed wording, accents, small connectives, punctuation, mathematical arguments, primes, superscripts, underlines, all rightward arrows, brace placement, marginal marks, three insertions, cancellations, and the unfinished final line. Fourteen single logged tight crops resolved or documented what remained open; no decided place was recropped and no half was enlarged again. All C doubt marks have a resolution or retained-doubt entry. H omits the upper paired strokes and foliation, gives the brace below the term, changes ta to la, and flattens or omits several insertion, deletion, and underline states. Possible extra punctuation before moi is retained uncertainly. No independent diagram or drawing is present: the mathematical chain is a display, and the lower-left shapes are copy impressions. All source_bbox values use original whole-page pixels; a list of boxes means a locus crosses physical lines.
